body:
NOTE: the dmt I smoked was 85% pure
Ok, I have only Smoke N-N-DMT once I smoked 70mg in two hits and broke through.....
I then started fading in and out from being a solid form to molecules back and forth, I heard a (pop or a buzzing) kind of sound then as I was fading in and out I saw the guy that held the dmt pipe for me turn into someone else, then a ball of blue light came from the top of his head it hit the ground next to him (on the right) as it hit the ground it bounced and a new person way made from the feet to the head, still fading in and out they started trying to talk to me but I didn't under stand the words(everything was staticy when I was in molecules form, then I stoped fading in and out, they again tryed talking to me still in these unknown words, then I could understand them the first thing they said to me was 'finally your here' like they had been waiting for some time but the voice sounded like they were happy I finally came, after that everything seems to be moving 100 times faster, so I only remember parts I started asking 'them' questions and they were giving me answers( I dont remember what I ask or what they said) , I opened up my head so that it was showing my brain then they were helping me 'deprogram 'my brain I was taking parts of my brain out then erasing what was on the little parts I pulled out then putting them back in, then I was flying around not as a body but as my 'soul' (the part of me inside my head that know I am me) it was the best thing I have ever experienced in my whole life, then I was in a place of nothing but the color white all around me(nothing but white in every direction) and I can see in a 360 view but there was only one thing to be seen it was a giant head with the top of the head gone and the face was smiling there was a rainbow going down into the head and it was spilling out of the eye's like rainbow water, then (at this point I thought I had woke up) I was walking down a dark street going to the house I smoke the dmt at I saw a person from the corner of my left eye, then bam someone hits me with a baseball bat on the left side of my head, my left eye, ear, nose and mouth were bleeding it felt so real more real then this world, I pulled a knife out and stabed the person that hit me in the head with the bat, then walked into the house I was going to, but on the way I talk to a very powerful (being) I felt it's power and did not want to make it mad, then I see nothing but white and 3 box's one with a head and a spinning gear, the other with a little rainbow and and the 3rd I cant remember what was there, next thing I know I'm watching ever channging color and objects, then I say to myself(think to my self) if I'm here in my head then I can change things......wrong thing to think after that I dont have any memorys but I know that I was the most terrorfing thing I have ever been through, I woke up looked to my right and saw a crazy looking oompa loompa , looked away then looked back it was gone closed my eye's still very tripping , a couple of minutes past then I look to my right again , there was a giant robot and I looked away thing it would try to hurt me, I looked back thinking this isn't bad then it tryed to grab me I closed my eye's , when I next opened my eye's I was seeing Spirals in the air and in the trees outside (tool was playing but it was not the Lateralus cd), within 15 minutes after waking up I was almost back to normal but I was still in a very uplifted mood like I had died and was reborn that feeling stayed with me for about a month giving me a new emotion better then happiness.
It's been about 5 months now and I'm going to take some pills next week ( a pill with one gram syrian_rue extract and another pill with 100mg or maybe a little more of 85%pure n-n-dmt) you know the 12 hour stuff, I'm going to ride the Spiral
